-- Average total leaf quantity across all final packaging combinations
WITH RECURSIVE expanded AS (
    SELECT 
        t.packaging_id AS root_id,
        p.id AS current_id,
        CAST(1 AS BIGINT) AS running_qty
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations
        EXCEPT
        SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations
    ) t
    JOIN packaging p ON p.id = t.packaging_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        e.root_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        e.running_qty * pr.qty AS running_qty
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = e.current_id
),
leaves AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT contains_id 
    FROM packaging_relations
    EXCEPT
    SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id 
    FROM packaging_relations
),
leaf_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        e.root_id,
        SUM(e.running_qty) AS total_leaf_qty
    FROM expanded e
    JOIN leaves l ON l.contains_id = e.current_id
    GROUP BY e.root_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_leaf_qty) AS average_total_quantity FROM leaf_totals

-- Recursive CTE to compute total quantity of each leaf item within each top-level container
-- Then filter for accumulated_qty > 500 and join with packaging names
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.packaging_id AS top_id,
        pr.contains_id AS item_id,
        pr.qty AS total_qty,
        1 AS depth
    FROM packaging_relations pr
    WHERE pr.packaging_id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        h.top_id,
        pr.contains_id,
        h.total_qty * pr.qty,
        h.depth + 1
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON h.item_id = pr.packaging_id
),
leaf_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        top_id,
        item_id,
        SUM(total_qty) AS accumulated_qty
    FROM hierarchy
    WHERE item_id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
    GROUP BY top_id, item_id
)
SELECT 
    top_p.name AS container_name,
    item_p.name AS item_name,
    lt.accumulated_qty
FROM leaf_totals lt
JOIN packaging top_p ON lt.top_id = top_p.id
JOIN packaging item_p ON lt.item_id = item_p.id
WHERE lt.accumulated_qty > 500
ORDER BY container_name, item_name

WITH order_lines AS (
    SELECT product_id, qty AS ordered_qty
    FROM orderlines
    WHERE order_id = 423
),
inventory_sorted AS (
    SELECT i.id, i.product_id, i.location_id, i.purchase_id, i.qty, l.warehouse, l.aisle, l.position, p.purchased,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty) AS rn
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.id
    JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1
),
cumulative AS (
    SELECT inv.*, ol.ordered_qty,
           SUM(inv.qty) OVER (PARTITION BY inv.product_id ORDER BY inv.purchased, inv.qty ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS cum_qty
    FROM inventory_sorted inv
    JOIN order_lines ol ON inv.product_id = ol.product_id
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT *,
           LAG(cum_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY purchased, qty) AS prev_cum_qty
    FROM cumulative
),
pick_calc AS (
    SELECT product_id, aisle, position, qty AS available_qty,
           CASE 
               WHEN prev_cum_qty IS NULL THEN LEAST(ordered_qty, qty)
               WHEN prev_cum_qty >= ordered_qty THEN 0
               ELSE LEAST(ordered_qty - COALESCE(prev_cum_qty, 0), qty)
           END AS pick_qty,
           ordered_qty
    FROM with_prev
)
SELECT product_id, aisle, position, available_qty, pick_qty, ordered_qty
FROM pick_calc
WHERE pick_qty > 0
ORDER BY product_id, available_qty

-- Compute average pick percentage per product name using FIFO approach
WITH RECURSIVE 
order_lines_ordered AS (
    SELECT 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ol.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered, ol.id) as rn,
        ol.product_id, p.name as product_name, ol.qty as order_qty
    FROM orderlines ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products p ON ol.product_id = p.id
),
product_inv AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) as total_inv
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY product_id
),
fifo AS (
    SELECT 
        ol.product_id,
        ol.product_name,
        ol.rn,
        ol.order_qty,
        COALESCE(pi.total_inv, 0) as inv_before,
        CASE WHEN ol.order_qty <= COALESCE(pi.total_inv, 0) THEN ol.order_qty ELSE COALESCE(pi.total_inv, 0) END as picked,
        COALESCE(pi.total_inv, 0) - CASE WHEN ol.order_qty <= COALESCE(pi.total_inv, 0) THEN ol.order_qty ELSE COALESCE(pi.total_inv, 0) END as inv_after
    FROM order_lines_ordered ol
    LEFT JOIN product_inv pi ON ol.product_id = pi.product_id
    WHERE ol.rn = 1
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        ol.product_id,
        ol.product_name,
        ol.rn,
        ol.order_qty,
        f.inv_after,
        CASE WHEN ol.order_qty <= f.inv_after THEN ol.order_qty ELSE f.inv_after END as picked,
        f.inv_after - CASE WHEN ol.order_qty <= f.inv_after THEN ol.order_qty ELSE f.inv_after END as inv_after
    FROM fifo f
    JOIN order_lines_ordered ol ON f.product_id = ol.product_id AND ol.rn = f.rn + 1
)
SELECT product_name,
       AVG(CASE WHEN order_qty > 0 THEN 1.0 * picked / order_qty ELSE 0 END) as avg_pick_percentage
FROM fifo
GROUP BY product_name
ORDER BY product_name
SELECT p.id as product_id, p.name, AVG(pl.qty) as avg_units_picked FROM picking_line pl JOIN products p ON pl.product_id = p.id WHERE pl.order_id = 421 GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    mth,
    qty,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) AS month_idx
  FROM monthly_sales
),
cma_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    m.product_id,
    m.mth,
    m.qty,
    m.month_idx,
    AVG(m1.qty) AS window1_avg,
    AVG(m2.qty) AS window2_avg
  FROM monthly m
  LEFT JOIN monthly m1 ON m.product_id = m1.product_id 
    AND m1.month_idx BETWEEN m.month_idx - 5 AND m.month_idx + 6
  LEFT JOIN monthly m2 ON m.product_id = m2.product_id 
    AND m2.month_idx BETWEEN m.month_idx - 6 AND m.month_idx + 5
  WHERE m.month_idx >= 7 AND m.month_idx <= 30
  GROUP BY m.product_id, m.mth, m.qty, m.month_idx
),
with_ratio AS (
  SELECT 
    product_id,
    mth,
    qty,
    qty / ((window1_avg + window2_avg) / 2.0) AS ratio
  FROM cma_calc
),
product_check AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ratio > 2) AS months_above_2,
         COUNT(*) AS total_months
  FROM with_ratio
  WHERE mth >= '2017-01-01' AND mth <= '2017-12-01'
  GROUP BY product_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ratio > 2) = COUNT(*)
)
SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name
FROM product_check pc
JOIN products p ON p.id = pc.product_id

-- Final comprehensive query to get the answer
WITH sales AS (
  SELECT product_id, mth, qty,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) AS time_step
  FROM monthly_sales
  WHERE product_id IN (4160, 7790)
),
cma_calc AS (
  SELECT s.product_id, s.mth, s.qty, s.time_step,
         (SELECT AVG(s2.qty * 1.0) FROM sales s2 
          WHERE s2.product_id = s.product_id AND s2.time_step BETWEEN s.time_step - 5 AND s.time_step + 6) AS window1,
         (SELECT AVG(s2.qty * 1.0) FROM sales s2 
          WHERE s2.product_id = s.product_id AND s2.time_step BETWEEN s.time_step - 6 AND s.time_step + 5) AS window2
  FROM sales s
),
with_cma AS (
  SELECT product_id, time_step, mth, qty,
         (window1 + window2) / 2.0 AS cma
  FROM cma_calc
),
with_ratio AS (
  SELECT product_id, time_step, mth, qty, cma,
         CASE WHEN cma > 0 THEN qty / cma ELSE NULL END AS sales_to_cma_ratio
  FROM with_cma
  WHERE time_step >= 7 AND time_step <= 30
),
seasonal_indices AS (
  SELECT product_id, 
         EXTRACT(MONTH FROM mth::DATE) AS month_num,
         AVG(sales_to_cma_ratio) AS raw_seasonal_factor
  FROM with_ratio
  GROUP BY product_id, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM mth::DATE)
),
normalized_seasonal AS (
  SELECT product_id, month_num, raw_seasonal_factor,
         raw_seasonal_factor / AVG(raw_seasonal_factor) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id) AS seasonal_factor
  FROM seasonal_indices
),
deseasonalized AS (
  SELECT s.product_id, s.time_step, s.mth, s.qty, ns.seasonal_factor,
         CASE WHEN ns.seasonal_factor > 0 THEN s.qty / ns.seasonal_factor ELSE NULL END AS deseasonalized_qty
  FROM sales s
  JOIN normalized_seasonal ns ON s.product_id = ns.product_id AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM s.mth::DATE) = ns.month_num
  WHERE s.time_step >= 7 AND s.time_step <= 30
),
weighted_stats AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         SUM(time_step * time_step * time_step) AS sum_wx2,
         SUM(time_step * time_step) AS sum_wx,
         SUM(time_step) AS sum_w,
         SUM(time_step * deseasonalized_qty) AS sum_wy,
         SUM(time_step * time_step * deseasonalized_qty) AS sum_wxy
  FROM deseasonalized
  GROUP BY product_id
),
regression_params AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         (sum_w * sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy) * 1.0 / (sum_w * sum_wx2 - sum_wx * sum_wx) AS slope,
         (sum_wy - ((sum_w * sum_wxy - sum_wx * sum_wy) * 1.0 / (sum_w * sum_wx2 - sum_wx * sum_wx)) * sum_wx) * 1.0 / sum_w AS intercept
  FROM weighted_stats
),
forecast_months AS (
  SELECT 25 AS time_step, 1 AS month_num UNION ALL SELECT 26, 2 UNION ALL SELECT 27, 3 UNION ALL
  SELECT 28, 4 UNION ALL SELECT 29, 5 UNION ALL SELECT 30, 6 UNION ALL
  SELECT 31, 7 UNION ALL SELECT 32, 8 UNION ALL SELECT 33, 9 UNION ALL
  SELECT 34, 10 UNION ALL SELECT 35, 11 UNION ALL SELECT 36, 12
),
forecasts AS (
  SELECT rp.product_id, fm.time_step, fm.month_num,
         (rp.intercept + rp.slope * fm.time_step) * ns.seasonal_factor AS forecasted_monthly_sales
  FROM regression_params rp
  CROSS JOIN forecast_months fm
  JOIN normalized_seasonal ns ON rp.product_id = ns.product_id AND fm.month_num = ns.month_num
),
annual_forecasts AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(forecasted_monthly_sales) AS annual_forecast_2018
  FROM forecasts
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT AVG(annual_forecast_2018) AS average_forecasted_annual_sales_2018
FROM annual_forecasts

WITH RECURSIVE inventory_model AS (
    SELECT 
        it.product_id,
        '2018-12-01'::DATE AS mth,
        it.qty AS ending_inventory,
        COALESCE(pm.qty_minimum, 0) AS qty_minimum,
        pm.qty_purchase,
        0 AS step
    FROM inventory_totals it
    LEFT JOIN product_minimums pm ON it.product_id = pm.product_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        im.product_id,
        im.mth + INTERVAL '1' MONTH AS mth,
        CASE 
            WHEN im.qty_minimum IS NOT NULL AND im.ending_inventory - COALESCE(ms.qty, 0) < im.qty_minimum
            THEN im.ending_inventory - COALESCE(ms.qty, 0) + im.qty_purchase
            ELSE im.ending_inventory - COALESCE(ms.qty, 0)
        END AS ending_inventory,
        im.qty_minimum,
        im.qty_purchase,
        im.step + 1
    FROM inventory_model im
    LEFT JOIN monthly_sales ms ON im.product_id = ms.product_id 
        AND ms.mth = '2018-' || LPAD(CAST(MONTH(im.mth + INTERVAL '1' MONTH) AS VARCHAR), 2, '0') || '-01'
    WHERE im.step < 12
),
with_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        mth,
        ending_inventory,
        qty_minimum,
        ABS(ending_inventory - qty_minimum) AS abs_diff
    FROM inventory_model
    WHERE mth >= '2019-01-01' AND mth <= '2019-12-01'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        product_id,
        mth,
        abs_diff,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY abs_diff ASC, mth ASC) AS rn
    FROM with_diff
)
SELECT product_id, mth, abs_diff
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY product_id

WITH match_points AS (
    SELECT 
        m.season,
        m.league_id,
        c.name as country_name,
        l.name as league_name,
        t_home.team_api_id as team_api_id,
        t_home.team_long_name as team_name,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
            WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as points
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
    JOIN Team t_home ON m.home_team_api_id = t_home.team_api_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        m.season,
        m.league_id,
        c.name as country_name,
        l.name as league_name,
        t_away.team_api_id as team_api_id,
        t_away.team_long_name as team_name,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3
            WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as points
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
    JOIN Team t_away ON m.away_team_api_id = t_away.team_api_id
),
team_points AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        league_id,
        country_name,
        league_name,
        team_api_id,
        team_name,
        SUM(points) as total_points
    FROM match_points
    GROUP BY season, league_id, country_name, league_name, team_api_id, team_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        league_id,
        country_name,
        league_name,
        team_api_id,
        team_name,
        total_points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season, league_id ORDER BY total_points DESC, team_name ASC) as rn
    FROM team_points
)
SELECT 
    season,
    country_name,
    league_name,
    team_name,
    total_points
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY season, league_id

WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG("loss_rate_%") AS avg_loss_rate,
    STDDEV("loss_rate_%") AS stddev_loss_rate
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
),
enriched AS (
  SELECT v.*, s.avg_loss_rate, s.stddev_loss_rate,
    s.avg_loss_rate - s.stddev_loss_rate AS lower_bound,
    s.avg_loss_rate + s.stddev_loss_rate AS upper_bound
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df v, stats s
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_loss_rate) AS avg_loss_rate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" < lower_bound THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS below_1stddev,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" > upper_bound THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS above_1stddev,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" BETWEEN lower_bound AND upper_bound THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_1stddev
FROM enriched

-- Build the full query with all metrics
WITH wholesale AS (
  SELECT 
    substr(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) as calendar_year,
    vc.category_name,
    ROUND(AVG(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as avg_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as max_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as min_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") - MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as wholesale_price_diff,
    ROUND(SUM(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) as total_wholesale_price
  FROM veg_whsle_df w
  JOIN veg_cat vc ON w.item_code = vc.item_code
  WHERE substr(w.whsle_date, 1, 4) IN ('2020', '2021', '2022', '2023')
  GROUP BY substr(w.whsle_date, 1, 4), vc.category_name
),
selling AS (
  SELECT 
    substr(t.txn_date, 1, 4) as calendar_year,
    vc.category_name,
    ROUND(SUM(t."qty_sold(kg)" * t."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg"), 2) as total_selling_price
  FROM veg_txn_df t
  JOIN veg_cat vc ON t.item_code = vc.item_code
  WHERE substr(t.txn_date, 1, 4) IN ('2020', '2021', '2022', '2023')
    AND t."sale/return" = 'sale'
  GROUP BY substr(t.txn_date, 1, 4), vc.category_name
),
loss_rate AS (
  SELECT 
    vc.category_name,
    ROUND(AVG(vlr."loss_rate_%"), 2) as avg_loss_rate
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df vlr
  JOIN veg_cat vc ON vlr.item_code = vc.item_code
  GROUP BY vc.category_name
)
SELECT 
  w.calendar_year,
  w.category_name,
  w.avg_wholesale_price,
  w.max_wholesale_price,
  w.min_wholesale_price,
  w.wholesale_price_diff,
  w.total_wholesale_price,
  s.total_selling_price,
  lr.avg_loss_rate,
  ROUND(w.total_wholesale_price * lr.avg_loss_rate / 100.0, 2) as total_loss,
  ROUND(s.total_selling_price - w.total_wholesale_price - (w.total_wholesale_price * lr.avg_loss_rate / 100.0), 2) as profit
FROM wholesale w
JOIN selling s ON w.calendar_year = s.calendar_year AND w.category_name = s.category_name
JOIN loss_rate lr ON w.category_name = lr.category_name
ORDER BY w.calendar_year, w.category_name

WITH seller_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_quantity,
        SUM(oi.price) as total_sales,
        AVG(oi.price) as avg_item_price
    FROM order_items oi
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
),
seller_reviews AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(orv.review_score) as avg_review_score
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN order_reviews orv ON oi.order_id = orv.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_packing AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CAST(o.order_delivered_carrier_date AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(o.order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP))) / 3600) as avg_packing_hours
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL 
      AND o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_top_category AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        pcat.product_category_name_english,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.seller_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC) as rn
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation pcat ON p.product_category_name = pcat.product_category_name
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id, pcat.product_category_name_english
)
SELECT 
    sm.seller_id,
    sm.total_quantity,
    sm.total_sales,
    sm.avg_item_price,
    COALESCE(sr.avg_review_score, 0) as avg_review_score,
    COALESCE(sp.avg_packing_hours, 0) as avg_packing_hours,
    stc.product_category_name_english as top_category_english
FROM seller_metrics sm
LEFT JOIN seller_reviews sr ON sm.seller_id = sr.seller_id
LEFT JOIN seller_packing sp ON sm.seller_id = sp.seller_id
LEFT JOIN seller_top_category stc ON sm.seller_id = stc.seller_id AND stc.rn = 1
ORDER BY sm.total_sales DESC

-- Calculate the percentage of customers with growth rate > 5%
WITH months AS (
    SELECT unnest([DATE '2020-01-01', DATE '2020-02-01', DATE '2020-03-01', DATE '2020-04-01']) as month_start
),
customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
customer_months AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, m.month_start
    FROM customers c
    CROSS JOIN months m
),
monthly_nets AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        date_trunc('month', CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as month_start,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                 WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
                 ELSE 0 END) as monthly_net
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
    GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', CAST(txn_date AS DATE))
),
combined AS (
    SELECT cm.customer_id, cm.month_start, COALESCE(mn.monthly_net, 0) as monthly_net
    FROM customer_months cm
    LEFT JOIN monthly_nets mn ON cm.customer_id = mn.customer_id AND cm.month_start = mn.month_start
),
with_cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        monthly_net,
        SUM(monthly_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) as closing_balance
    FROM combined
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        closing_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start DESC) as rn
    FROM with_cumulative
),
most_recent AS (
    SELECT customer_id, month_start as most_recent_month, closing_balance as recent_balance
    FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
),
prior_month AS (
    SELECT customer_id, closing_balance as prior_balance
    FROM ranked WHERE rn = 2
),
growth AS (
    SELECT 
        m.customer_id,
        m.recent_balance,
        COALESCE(p.prior_balance, 0) as prior_balance,
        CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(p.prior_balance, 0) = 0 THEN m.recent_balance * 100
            ELSE (m.recent_balance - COALESCE(p.prior_balance, 0)) * 100.0 / p.prior_balance
        END as growth_rate
    FROM most_recent m
    LEFT JOIN prior_month p ON m.customer_id = p.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as total_customers,
    SUM(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as customers_above_5,
    1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100 as percentage_above_5
FROM growth

-- Final version: For each month, total balance from all users for the previous month
-- measured as of the 1st of each month, negative balances replaced with zero
-- First month excluded from output
WITH daily_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date::DATE as txn_date,
        SUM(
            CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                 WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount 
                 WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
                 ELSE 0 END
        ) as daily_change
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
cumulative_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        daily_change,
        SUM(daily_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as running_balance
    FROM daily_balances
),
month_starts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month', txn_date::DATE) as month_start
    FROM customer_transactions
),
all_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
customer_month AS (
    SELECT m.month_start, c.customer_id
    FROM month_starts m, all_customers c
),
balance_at_month AS (
    SELECT 
        cm.month_start,
        cm.customer_id,
        c.running_balance as balance
    FROM customer_month cm
    LEFT JOIN cumulative_balances c ON c.customer_id = cm.customer_id AND c.txn_date < cm.month_start
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cm.month_start, cm.customer_id ORDER BY c.txn_date DESC) = 1
),
adjusted_balances AS (
    SELECT month_start, customer_id, GREATEST(COALESCE(balance, 0), 0) as adjusted_balance
    FROM balance_at_month
),
monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT month_start, SUM(adjusted_balance) as total_balance FROM adjusted_balances GROUP BY month_start
)
SELECT month_start, total_balance 
FROM monthly_totals 
WHERE month_start > (SELECT MIN(month_start) FROM monthly_totals)
ORDER BY month_start

WITH daily_changes AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) as daily_net
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
customer_date_range AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date) as first_date, MAX(txn_date) as last_date
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, d.date_val
  FROM customer_date_range c
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT date_val FROM generate_series(CAST(c.first_date AS DATE), CAST(c.last_date AS DATE), INTERVAL '1' DAY) AS t(date_val)
  ) d
),
daily_balances AS (
  SELECT ad.customer_id, ad.date_val,
    COALESCE(dc.daily_net, 0) as daily_net,
    SUM(COALESCE(dc.daily_net, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY ad.customer_id ORDER BY ad.date_val ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as running_balance
  FROM all_dates ad
  LEFT JOIN daily_changes dc ON ad.customer_id = dc.customer_id AND ad.date_val = dc.txn_date
),
rolling_avg AS (
  SELECT customer_id, date_val, running_balance,
    AVG(running_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY date_val ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as avg_30day
  FROM daily_balances
),
filtered_avg AS (
  SELECT ra.customer_id, ra.date_val,
    CASE WHEN ra.avg_30day < 0 THEN 0 ELSE ra.avg_30day END as avg_30day_clamped,
    cdr.first_date
  FROM rolling_avg ra
  JOIN customer_date_range cdr ON ra.customer_id = cdr.customer_id
  WHERE (CAST(ra.date_val AS DATE) - CAST(cdr.first_date AS DATE)) >= 29
),
with_month AS (
  SELECT customer_id, date_val, avg_30day_clamped, first_date,
    date_trunc('month', CAST(date_val AS DATE)) as month_val
  FROM filtered_avg
),
max_per_customer_month AS (
  SELECT customer_id, month_val,
    MAX(avg_30day_clamped) as max_avg
  FROM with_month
  GROUP BY customer_id, month_val
),
first_months AS (
  SELECT customer_id, date_trunc('month', CAST(first_date AS DATE)) as first_month
  FROM customer_date_range
),
excluded AS (
  SELECT m.customer_id, m.month_val, m.max_avg
  FROM max_per_customer_month m
  LEFT JOIN first_months fm ON m.customer_id = fm.customer_id AND m.month_val = fm.first_month
  WHERE fm.first_month IS NULL
)
SELECT 
  month_val,
  SUM(max_avg) as total_max_avg
FROM excluded
GROUP BY month_val
ORDER BY month_val

-- Final result with proper types
WITH date_range AS (
    SELECT CAST(d AS DATE) as txn_date
    FROM generate_series(DATE '2020-01-01', DATE '2020-04-28', INTERVAL '1 day') as t(d)
),
customer_date_range AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as min_date, MAX(CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as max_date
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, d.txn_date
    FROM customer_date_range c
    CROSS JOIN date_range d
    WHERE d.txn_date BETWEEN c.min_date AND c.max_date
),
daily_transactions AS (
    SELECT 
        a.customer_id,
        a.txn_date,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE 
            WHEN t.txn_type = 'deposit' THEN t.txn_amount
            WHEN t.txn_type IN ('purchase', 'withdrawal') THEN -t.txn_amount
            ELSE 0
        END), 0) as daily_net
    FROM all_dates a
    LEFT JOIN customer_transactions t ON a.customer_id = t.customer_id AND CAST(a.txn_date AS VARCHAR) = t.txn_date
    GROUP BY a.customer_id, a.txn_date
),
cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        daily_net,
        SUM(daily_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as raw_balance
    FROM daily_transactions
),
balanced AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        txn_date,
        GREATEST(raw_balance, 0) as daily_balance
    FROM cumulative
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', txn_date) AS VARCHAR) as month,
        customer_id,

-- Now let me calculate the overall averages
-- first_round_missed and last_round_missed are the round numbers of the first and last missed races
-- We need to average these across all qualifying driver-year entries

WITH driver_drives AS (
  SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, first_round, last_round,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY first_round) as stint_num
  FROM drives
),
all_pairs AS (
  SELECT dd1.year, dd1.driver_id, dd1.stint_num as prev_stint, dd1.constructor_id as prev_constructor, 
         dd1.first_round as prev_first, dd1.last_round as prev_last,
         dd2.stint_num as next_stint, dd2.constructor_id as next_constructor,
         dd2.first_round as next_first, dd2.last_round as next_last
  FROM driver_drives dd1
  JOIN driver_drives dd2 ON dd1.year = dd2.year AND dd1.driver_id = dd2.driver_id AND dd2.stint_num > dd1.stint_num
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT year, driver_id, prev_constructor, prev_last, next_constructor, next_first,
         next_first - prev_last - 1 as missed_races
  FROM all_pairs
  WHERE next_first - prev_last - 1 > 0
),
driver_totals AS (
  SELECT year, driver_id, 
         SUM(missed_races) as total_missed,
         MIN(prev_last) as last_before_first_gap,
         MAX(next_first - 1) as first_after_last_gap
  FROM gaps
  GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT year, driver_id, total_missed, last_before_first_gap, first_after_last_gap
  FROM driver_totals
  WHERE total_missed < 3
),
prev_constructor_info AS (
  SELECT dd.year, dd.driver_id, dd.constructor_id
  FROM driver_drives dd
  JOIN qualifying q ON dd.year = q.year AND dd.driver_id = q.driver_id
  WHERE dd.last_round = q.last_before_first_gap
),
next_constructor_info AS (
  SELECT dd.year, dd.driver_id, dd.constructor_id
  FROM driver_drives dd
  JOIN qualifying q ON dd.year = q.year AND dd.driver_id = q.driver_id
  WHERE dd.first_round = q.first_after_last_gap + 1
),
qualified_entries AS (
  SELECT q.year, q.driver_id, 
         q.last_before_first_gap + 1 as first_round_missed,
         q.first_after_last_gap as last_round_missed,
         p.constructor_id as constructor_before,
         n.constructor_id as constructor_after
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN prev_constructor_info p ON q.year = p.year AND q.driver_id = p.driver_id
  JOIN next_constructor_info n ON q.year = n.year AND q.driver_id = n.driver_id
  WHERE p.constructor_id != n.constructor_id
)
SELECT AVG(first_round_missed) as avg_first_round_missed,
       AVG(last_round_missed) as avg_last_round_missed
FROM qualified_entries
